signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to manage your email.
signIn.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
signIn.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
signIn.mailboxForgot: Mailbox owners: forgot your password? Ask your domain's manager.
signIn.mailboxOnly: I want to manage my mailbox
signIn.mailboxOnlyHint: Tick this if your EmailSquire account has the same password as your mailbox.

setup.title: Set your password
setup.subtitle: You will use it to sign in to EmailSquire.
setup.missingEmail: This setup link is missing the email address.

twoFactor.title: Enter your code
twoFactor.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for <0>{{email}}</0>.
twoFactor.recoverySubtitle: Type one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor authentication. Each code works once.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a link. It works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Setting it signs you out everywhere. Then sign in with the new password.
reset.missingEmail: This reset link is missing the email address.

invitation.title: You're invited
invitation.subtitle: Accept the invitation to start using EmailSquire.
invitation.name: Your name
invitation.acceptPrompt: You're signed in as {{email}}. Accept to add this access to your account.
invitation.signInPrompt: This invitation is for {{email}}. Sign in as that address to accept it.
invitation.wrongAccount: This invitation is for {{invited}}. Sign out, then sign in as that address to accept it.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitation links work for 72 hours. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

used.title: This invitation has already been used
used.body: If you accepted it, sign in to continue.

revoked.title: This invitation is no longer valid
revoked.body: It was withdrawn. Ask the person who invited you if you still need access.

invalid.title: This invitation link is not valid
invalid.body: Open the whole link from the email, or ask for a new invitation.

invitation.loadFailed: The invitation could not be loaded.

session.title: You're signed in
session.retryText: Your profile could not be loaded. Try again to continue.
